text:
lina: opened a PR to add zenith13b model card + a short migration guide for SDK v4. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5033 Preview: https://deploy-preview.example/5033 — includes supported_variants, quantization_profiles, max_sequence_length for 32k context, and a compact throughput section. looking for docs + eng review.

devin: can you include a minimal Go snippet? we have a couple of infra teams using Go. also QA asked for p50/p95 on V100 and T4 for 8k/32k.

lina: added a Go streaming example and microbench numbers: V100 8k p50 320 tok/s p95 240; 32k p50 95 tok/s p95 70. T4 roughly 45-50% of V100. noted variability with mixed-batch padding (~12%).

hao: small schema nit: frontmatter used "seq_limit" — catalog expects "max_sequence_length". linter will flag.

lina: fixed to "max_sequence_length" and pushed. thanks.

marta: please add an embeddings fallback note — recommend "variant: \"sparse-lite\"" or "quant_profile: \"cpu-int8\"" for CPU-only hosts and mention throughput hit (~4x slower).

lina: added embeddings fallback paragraph and a short evaluation command link (internal): https://bench.internal/zenith13b/5033.
devin: link check: the TOC anchor points at "#quant-profiles" but docs site uses "#quantization-profiles" — will 404 in prod.
lina: fixed anchor and updated TOC.

hao: can eng-ml sign off on the CPU quality wording? avoid absolute statements about hallucination. @marta?
marta: adjusted language to "may alter short-token preferences; run representative evals before rolling out" and removed any strong claims. added a redirect to the eval harness.

deploy-bot: preview build passed ✅ — staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/5033. Lint: 1 warning (link style) resolved.\

lina: added a concise migration checklist in the PR description (field rename, new enum values for quant_profile and supported_variants, snippet changes for SDK v4 Go/Node/Python). requesting final approvals from @devin @hao @marta. will merge after one approval. :rocket:
